summary.text: Haraz Ghanbari is a Republican member of the Ohio House of Representatives for District 75 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia says he was a U.S. Navy Reserve public affairs officer and a Perrysburg city councilman before joining the House.

paragraphs.text: Ghanbari was a public affairs officer in the U.S. Navy Reserve at the time of his appointment to the Ohio House, and he served on the Perrysburg city council.

He previously worked as director of military and veteran affairs at the University of Toledo and as a staff photo journalist in the Associated Press Washington bureau, where he was part of the White House Press Corps.
Ballotpedia lists his Ohio House tenure as beginning in 2019 and he assumed office in District 75 on January 1, 2023.
He defeated Sally Culling in the March 19, 2024 Republican primary and Jan Materni in the November 5, 2024 general election.
His current committees are Arts, Athletics, and Tourism; Public Safety; Small Business, which he chairs; and Veterans and Military Development.
Richard Rettig is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
